hypothesis: A shared carrier-writing subcircuit can be selected more robustly by optimizing one exact component program across both tasks, using multi-task agreement as regularization against the is/was fit split's small-sample overfitting.

frozen_design.candidate_pool: The 17 component labels in the intersection of the two pre-outcome weight-frozen pools.
frozen_design.fit: Jointly capable A1 fit only: 16 has/had and 8 is/was rows.
frozen_design.objective: At every greedy step, minimize the equal-task mean of has/had and is/was rowwise MSE to unit donor recovery.
frozen_design.intervention: The same exact joint head/module program is patched at each task's own paired contextual carrier bank.
frozen_design.sealed_evaluation: A1 heldout and A2 for both tasks; no task-specific additions.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_exact_instru: All panels remain capable and exact carrier widths recur.
predictions.pred_b_shared_path_is_distributive: The common path selects 2-6 components and every step strictly reduces equal-task fit MSE.
predictions.pred_c_shared_path_generalizes_to_both_a: Both heldout A1 panels have mean recovery at least 0.70, direction fraction at least 0.80, and unit-target RMSE below their best common-pool singleton.
predictions.pred_d_shared_path_transfers_to_both_a2_: Both A2 panels satisfy the same 0.70 recovery, 0.80 direction, and best-singleton bars.
predictions.pred_e_multitask_regularization_repairs_: is/was heldout mean recovery exceeds the prior task-specific program's 0.6542596410 while has/had heldout remains at least 0.6862649360 (within 0.05 of its prior 0.7362649360).
predictions.pred_f_price_and_coverage: At most 270 forwards, 3744 example evaluations, and 3562 intervention records; zero fitted scalars, backward passes, or model updates.

decision: screen only if all predictions pass; null on a scientific prediction failure; invalid on authority, capability, instrument, coverage, or price failure
heldout_policy: All program selection uses only the two A1 fit panels.
